Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.label: Greater Thurian League
Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.description: The oldest and largest of the leagues. Its kin are deep-core miners and heavy industrialists, grown for long shifts in the rock.

Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.label: Trans-Hyperian Alliance
Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.description: A sprawling network of trade holds strung along the hyperspace routes. Its kin are traders and void-farers.

Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.label: Kronus Hegemony
Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.description: The most militant of the leagues, forward-deployed and hard-edged. Its kin are drilled for war from the crucible.

Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.label: Ymyr Conglomerate
Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.description: A league of master artificers whose forges are the envy of the galaxy. Its kin are engineers and smiths.

Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.label: Urani-Surtr Regulates
Votann40k.KinLeagueDef.description: A league born in the furnace glare of a binary star. Its kin are hardened to heat, cold and poison.
